  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FOURTH SEMESTER B.TECH END SEMESTER EXAMINATIONS, MAY-JUNE 2023  
  LINUX PROGRAMMING [CSE4303]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  Instructions to Candidates: Answer ALL questions Missing data may be suitably assumed  
  1)           Illustrate the difference between su and sudo with suitable examples.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Write a shell script that accepts a number and check if it is prime or not.  
  (3)  
  
  C)      How Linux differs from other operating systems?  
  (2)  
  
  2)           Explain Linux file permission structure in detail. Write suitable commands to change file  
  permissions with example.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Interpret the purpose of the following vi editor commands.  
  
  i)d0  
  
  ii)2yy                                                                                      (3)  
  
  iii)x  
  
  
  C)      Demonstrate any two variants of ls command with its functionality.  
  (2)  
  
  3)           Explain the following search pattern that can be used with grep filter  
  
  i)gg* ii) [^a-zA-Z] iii) [pqr] iv)* v) .*                                                   (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain following terms in git.  
  
  i)git log  
  (3)  
  ii)git status

  C)         Explain the functionality of bin and lib directory of Linux filesystem.  
  (2)  
  
  4)              Assume you have a directory containing a large number of files with names that include  
  spaces and special characters. Your task is to write a script that will rename all the files  
  in the directory to be lowercase and replace spaces with underscores. Write a shell script (5)  
  A)         using a for loop to accomplish this task.  
  
  
  B)         Answer the following with respect to process handling in Linux:  
  
  i. What command can be used to view a list of currently running processes in  
  Linux? Give an example of how this command might be used.  
  
  ii. How can the "kill" command be used to terminate a process in Linux?                   (3)  
  
  iii. What command can be used to change the priority of a running process in Linux?  
  Give an example.  
  
  
  C)         What is the Linux kernel, and what is its role in the operating system?  
  (2)  
  
  5)              Write AWK program for the following tasks:  
  
  i. To count the number of occurrences of each word in a file, using an associative  
  A)                array to keep track of the counts and a loop to iterate over the words.  
  (5)  
  ii. To print the lines of a file that contain a pattern “your_name” repeated more than  
  three times. Use a loop to iterate over the characters of the pattern.  
  
  
  B)         Given a text file "example.txt" containing some lines, use SED editor to perform the  
  following operations:  
  
  i.Delete the first line.  
  (3)  
  ii.Replace all occurrences of the word "apple" with "orange".  
  
  iii.Append the text "The end" to the end of the file.  
  
  
  C)         Evaluate the importance of the "svn log" command in Subversion Control.  
  (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
